## Change

Describe the operation or inference path changed and why it should improve it.

## Correctness

Provide commands, fixtures, tolerance, and results. Explain any accuracy change.

## Performance evidence

Name the metric, baseline commit, candidate commit, hardware, compiler/driver,
model/quantization/context, clocks/power policy, temperature conditions,
sample count and ordering. Attach raw measurements and the control result.
Separate operation timings from end-to-end LLM timings.

## Reproduction

Provide exact commands and note unsupported shapes, dtypes or platforms.
